Apologies if the title might be a bit misleading but for years whenever I've woken up with a hand asleep or such I've always just focused on it intently for a few seconds and it would always as if it never had fallen asleep. When I was younger I used to believe that this was something extraordinary but later I came to realize that no matter how it felt when I focused on a part of me (whether it was asleep or not) all I was doing was increasing blood-flow to the intended area, which is obviously great for limbs that have limited blood flowing to them but little else. Now while this has come to me with quite a bit of ease after the practice I put into learning this years ago, I've always wondered if this little trick might be common that in my aspergers I failed to pick up on the allusions towards, but conversely the fact that I've never heard anyone speak of it directly leads me to believe that it's not very well known if known by anyone else...

So voat, do you know how to manipulate your blood-flow with conscious thought?
Is anyone else able to influence their blood with their mind?
